reference_planes.definition: Coaxial mating/calibration planes of the three installed 2.92 mm connectors
reference_planes.excitation: All three calibrated coaxial fundamental modes; all unexcited ports terminated in 50 ohm

required_model_scope: Exact exported DUT copper and solder attachment
All microstrip feeds, actual bend shapes and pin-to-line tapers
All three 1092-03A-6 connectors: pins, dielectric, shells, mounting blocks and contacts
Finite board edges, 0.51 mm RO4350B core and actual ground geometry
Ground rails, plated vias, NPTH holes, connector clamps and mounting hardware
Finite copper thickness and conductivity; laminate loss, copper roughness and ENIG
Actual soldermask openings and dielectric loading
CH02016 100 ohm resistor package and its parasitics, without counting its pads twice

required_capabilities: Finite substrate, finite ground, vias and contacts
Packaged resistor or verified EM/circuit co-simulation
solver.capability_note: Native YAPNR BoardSpec is insufficient for the full assembly. YAPNR has broader openEMS/PALACE integrations, but the audited interface still requires manual stack/port and assembly model construction; no supported minimal-code full-assembly adapter was identified.
solver.engine_capability: Both are suitable 3D EM engines; no claim that either engine is incapable
solver.backend_selection_basis: openEMS as the existing sweep workhorse; PALACE as independent FEM comparison
available_yapnr_integrations: openEMS/PALACE task images and cloud campaign planners

acceptance.coherent_inputs: Equal amplitude and phase at J2/J3 coaxial reference planes

numerical_validation.convergence_threshold_basis: Project engineering acceptance, not manufacturer datasheet limits

tolerance_validation.ranges: Use vendor-supported manufacturing limits; no invented ranges

required_evidence: Full complex 3-port Touchstone at connector planes
Geometry and material model files with provenance and hashes
All RF metrics compared with connector-plane limits
Solver version, settings and reproducible invocation

release_gate.missing_required_model_action: BLOCK assembly validation; never report a substituted planar/DUT model as whole-assembly validation

unified_model_contract.schema_requirement: One versioned, solver-neutral assembly SSoT; extend or reuse the existing planar model as appropriate
source_inputs: Component part identifiers or qualified model registry references
yapnr_responsibilities: Read board/assembly and resolve part models
Normalize complete geometry, materials, contacts and circuit models into the SSoT
Generate openEMS and PALACE inputs through supported adapters
Define meshes, ports, loss representations and EM/circuit coupling from the common model
Validate model coverage and solver capabilities before execution
Run excitation/convergence campaigns and publish results and requirements evidence
shared_definitions: Ports, calibration planes and impedance normalization
unified_model_contract.traceability: Every solver input and result must reference the same canonical assembly geometry/material/model hash, its adapter/version, declared numerical approximations and settings
